charge_port.notes: Estimated: The GM 2026 Silverado EV spec guide treats the J1772/CCS1 inlet as native with an optional NACS DC adapter; the Sierra EV is the same truck. Model years 2025-2026.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM announced the NACS adapter for all GM EVs on 2024-09-18, US first and Canada before the end of 2024 (Auto123, ArenaEV); no Canadian page for this exact model was readable (gm.ca, chevrolet.ca, cadillaccanada.ca return 403). Assumed the Canadian car has the same adapter access as the US car. Markets on this powertrain: CA and US; US reads InsideEVs' list.

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(11.5 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time. Standard charger; the 19.2 kW version is a separate option.
NRCan lists this car as "(19.2 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time.
